name: Lunds Konsthall
known: Swedish Wikipedia lists Åsa Nacking as director from 2003.

Kunstkritikk reports that a conservative minority with support from the Sweden Democrats intended to save 3 million Swedish kronor from the budget; board chairman Joakim Friberg (Social Democrat) claims the reconstruction is unrelated to the savings of around 3 million kronor (Frida Sandström, 17 De

name: Malmö Konsthall
known: Artistic directors: Eje Högestätt 1975 to 1986, Björn Springfeldt 1986 to 1990, Sune Nordgren 1990 to 1996, Bera Nordal 1997 to 2002, Lars Grambye 2003 to 2007, Jacob Fabricius 2007 to 2013, Diana Baldon 2014 to 2016, and Mats Stjernstedt from 2017 (Malmö Konsthall, "50 years" page).
Malmö stad announced Stjernstedt's appointment on 12 September 2016, with Culture Director Elisabeth Lundgren quoted.
Culture Director Elisabeth Lundgren gave the city's reasons for appointing Mats Stjernstedt as its head in 2016 (Malmö stad, 12 September 2016).

name: Bonniers Konsthall
known: Joanna Nordin became artistic director in April 2023, succeeding Theodor Ringborg, who started in 2019 (press release, 20 October 2022).
A foundation manages the estate and is chaired by her niece, Christel Engelbert.

name: Index - The Swedish Contemporary Art Foundation
known: Directors: Mats Stjernstedt 2001 to 2011, Diana Baldon 2011 to 2014, Axel Wieder 2014 to 2018, Marti Manen 2018 to 2026. Övül Ö.
Durmuşoğlu has been director since 2026 (Index).

The 2025 director vacancy notice repeats the same three funders, says the board holds ultimate financial responsibility, and asks the director to raise funds from both private and public sources (e-flux, 20 November 2025).
The board is listed on the site: Malin Hüber (chair), Koshik Zaman (vice chair), Johanna Billing, Olga Krzeszowiec Malmsten, Hanna Ljungh, Masha Taavoniku and Didem Yıldırım (Index).

name: Konsthall C
known: Directors named in the press: Jens Strandberg and Jenny Richards from 2015, succeeding Karolin Tampere (Kunstkritikk, 2015).
Ulrika Flink as artistic director and Erik Annerborn as managing director in 2023, when a three-year artistic directorship for 2024 to 2026 was advertised (e-flux call).

name: Magasin III
known: Robert Weil is chairman and founder of the foundation (Weil Foundation).

name: Moderna Museet
known: Pontus Hultén was the first director, from 1958 to 1973, and in 2005 bequeathed more than 700 works with his archive and library (Wikipedia).
Director since 2019: Gitte Ørskou (Wikipedia).
Bank of America's Art Conservation Project finances the conservation of Jean Tinguely's iron sculptures in Le Paradis Fantastique, begun in 2023 and continued in 2025 (annual report 2025).

name: Tensta konsthall
known: Wikipedia names the artist and social worker Gregor Wroblewski as founder.
Directors after him: Rodrigo Mallea Lira, Ylva Ogland and Jelena Rundqvist, William Easton, Maria Lind, and Cecilia Widenheim (Wikipedia).
The board is chaired by Karin Lekberg (tenstakonsthall.se).

name: Kunsthalle Basel
known: Mohamed Almusibli has been director and chief curator since 2024.
In November 2023 an SVP member of the cantonal parliament demanded subsidy be cut over director Almusibli's ceasefire letters; the canton did not act.

name: Kunstmuseum Basel
known: Wikipedia lists Elena Filipovic as director.

name: Schaulager
known: Extension: in October 2024 Herzog & de Meuron were named for an extension for large installations and multimedia works rarely lent, with an auditorium, seminar rooms and conservation studios, linked to the existing building.
